messages.text: Based on current vault evidence, what are the strongest opportunities for Signaling / Non-signaling Tester in Aerospace / Defense, and what evidence supports each opportunity?

Based on the current vault evidence, I found **no RAW passage that explicitly names Aerospace / Defense customers or directly states “A&D use case” for Signaling / Non-signaling Testers**. So the strongest opportunities below are **evidence-backed by adjacent technical requirements** that are highly relevant to A&D programs, especially NTN, 5G/6G research, mmWave/OTA, and secure/high-throughput wireless production test.

## Strongest opportunities

### 1. NTN / Direct-to-Cell device and network testing with CMX500

**Opportunity:**  
A&D organizations working on satellite communications, non-terrestrial networks, tactical connectivity, resilient comms, or direct-to-cell services are strong prospects for **CMX500-based NTN testing**.

**Why it is strong:**  
The vault evidence says the CMX500 has become an all-in-one NTN test platform supporting **NR-NTN, NB-NTN, and Direct-to-Cell / D2C / DTC**, and can test both **network and device level** in one unit. That maps well to A&D needs around satellite-enabled connectivity and mission-resilient communications.

**Evidence:**  
> “The CMX500 from Rohde & Schwarz has evolved into a versatile, all-in-one platform for NTN testing, supporting NR-NTN, NB-NTN and Direct-to-Cell (D2C, DTC) technologies within a single unit. With the CMX500, users can now test all NTN technologies on both network and device level, without the need for multiple instruments…”  
Source: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026.md`, section 3.

---

### 2. FR3 / 5G-Advanced / 6G R&D with CMX500

**Opportunity:**  
A&D labs researching next-generation secure wireless, spectrum-agile radios, private/tactical 5G, or early 6G concepts are strong targets for **CMX500 one-box signaling tester** deployments.

**Why it is strong:**  
The vault evidence positions CMX500 as a **future-proof, multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester** suitable for **FR3 research** and as a key platform for **5G-Advanced and 6G R&D**. FR3 and 6G research are likely strategic areas for defense labs and advanced aerospace communications programs.

**Evidence:**  
> “The test setup is based on the CMX500 OBT, a future-proof multi-technology, multi-channel one-box signaling tester… Its versatility allows for easy adaptation to different NR numerologies, making it the ideal choice for FR3 research and development.”  
Source: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz and Qualcomm unlock potential of proposed FR3 frequency range for next generation 6G wireless networks.md`, section 4.

Additional evidence:  
> “This all-in-one test platform supports both SA and NSA architectures, covers frequency ranges from FR1 to FR3, up to 18 GHz, and features a built-in IMS server, enabling one-stop testing for RF conformance, protocol validation, VoNR acoustics and carrier aggregation. With these capabilities, the CMX500 serves as a key test platform for 5G-Advanced and 6G research and development.”  
Source: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz and China Mobile Research Institute jointly demonstrate generative AI user experience testing.md`, section 5.

---

### 3. OTA testing for 5G FR1 / FR2 mmWave, RedCap, and Wi-Fi 7 devices

**Opportunity:**  
A&D device developers and system integrators needing over-the-air validation of connected platforms, sensors, ruggedized terminals, private 5G devices, or mmWave links are strong prospects for **CMX500 + OTA chamber** solutions.

**Why it is strong:**  
The vault evidence shows CMX500 being combined with OTA chambers for accurate device performance testing across **LTE, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, FR2 mmWave up to 50 GHz, 5G RedCap, and Wi-Fi 7**. This supports environments where cabled testing is insufficient and full radiated performance must be verified.

**Evidence:**  
> “EMITE’s state-of-the-art over-the-air chambers can now be combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of the R&S CMX500 one-box signaling tester… supporting cellular technologies such as LTE, 5G NR FR1 frequency range up to 8 GHz and FR2 millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz, including the latest 5G RedCap technology. It also supports non-cellular technologies, including the latest Wi-Fi 7, all in a single instrument.”  
Source: `raw/Productions/PR/EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap.md`, section 3.

---

### 4. High-throughput non-signaling production test for WLAN / Wi-Fi 7 / future Wi-Fi 8-class devices with CMP180

**Opportunity:**  
A&D production or qualification teams building secure Wi-Fi, mission-network devices, industrial wireless modules, avionics-adjacent connectivity modules, or high-throughput WLAN products are strong prospects for **CMP180 non-signaling RF test**.

**Why it is strong:**  
The vault evidence directly states that WLAN production RF measurements are performed in **non-signaling mode to save time**, and that the CMP180 is optimized for this purpose. It supports cellular and non-cellular technologies including **Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7, and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz**, with bandwidths up to **500 MHz** and 480 MHz waveform verification.

**Evidence:**  
> “In the production phase of WLAN devices, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time. Rohde & Schwarz has optimized the R&S CMP180 radio communication tester for this purpose. The instrument supports many cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz in frequency with bandwidths up to 500 MHz.”  
Source: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`, section 12.

Additional evidence:  
> “The R&S CMP180 radio communication tester will verify a signal waveform of 480 MHz bandwidth in loopback mode, attesting to be a future-proof solution for users in R&D and production, even beyond the requirements of Wi-Fi 7.”  
Source: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`, section 3.

---

### 5. Single-instrument cellular + non-cellular test consolidation with CMX500 / CMP180

**Opportunity:**  
A&D programs with mixed wireless stacks — cellular, private 5G, Wi-Fi 7, RedCap, NTN, and future standards — can be targeted with the value proposition of **test consolidation**: fewer instruments, faster development, broader technology coverage.

**Why it is strong:**  
The evidence repeatedly emphasizes “one-box,” “multi-technology,” and “multi-channel” test capabilities. For A&D labs, where test environments often span multiple standards and frequency bands, a consolidated platform can reduce setup complexity and accelerate validation.

**Evidence:**  
> “Rohde & Schwarz will display its R&S CMX500 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester… With this functionality, the one-box tester allows R&D engineers of wireless devices to comprehensively test their design’s operation in cellular and non-cellular standards of the latest generation in a single instrument setup.”  
Source: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024.md`, section 3.

And for NTN:  
> “With the CMX500, users can now test all NTN technologies on both network and device level, without the need for multiple instruments…”  
Source: `raw/Productions/PR/Rohde & Schwarz highlights its unique CMX500 one-box tester tailored for NTN testing at MWC Barcelona 2026.md`, section 3.

---

## Priority ranking

1. **NTN / Direct-to-Cell testing with CMX500** — strongest A&D fit because satellite and resilient communications are directly relevant to aerospace/defense.
2. **FR3 / 5G-Advanced / 6G R&D with CMX500** — strong fit for advanced defense research and future spectrum programs.
3. **OTA mmWave / RedCap / Wi-Fi 7 testing with CMX500 + chambers** — strong for device validation, rugged terminals, and radiated-performance testing.
4. **CMP180 non-signaling WLAN / Wi-Fi 7 production test** — strong where A&D has production or qualification of high-throughput wireless devices.
5. **Platform consolidation across cellular + non-cellular standards** — broad strategic opportunity, useful as a cross-sell or lab modernization message.

**Bottom line:** The vault does not directly prove A&D adoption, but it strongly supports a technical opportunity narrative: **CMX500 for NTN, FR3/6G, and OTA multi-standard signaling test; CMP180 for fast non-signaling WLAN and 5G FR1 production/R&D test.**

passages.text: EMITE’s state-of-the-art over-the-air chambers can now be combined with the latest sophisticated testing features of the [R&S CMX500](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/wireless-tester-network-emulator/cmx500-5g-one-box-signaling-tester_63493-601282.html "CMX500") one-box signaling tester from Rohde & Schwarz. The radio communication tester offers a wide range of device testing capabilities, supporting cellular technologies such as LTE, 5G NR FR1 frequency range up to 8 GHz and FR2 millimeter wave frequency range up to 50 GHz, including the latest 5G RedCap technology. It also supports non-cellular technologies, including the latest Wi-Fi 7, all in a single instrument. As a consequence of this collaboration, EMITE’s customers obtain a comprehensive environment for accurately assessing the performance of Wi-Fi 7 as well as 5G Red Cap devices.

cited_passages.text: In the production phase of WLAN devices, all RF measurements are performed in non-signaling mode to save time. Rohde & Schwarz has optimized the [R&S CMP180](https://www.rohde-schwarz.com/us/products/test-and-measurement/wireless-tester-rf-analyzer-generator/cmp180-radio-communication-tester_63493-1081280.html "CMP180") radio communication tester for this purpose. The instrument supports many cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi-Fi 6E, Wi-Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz in frequency with bandwidths up to 500 MHz. Leveraging the wide bandwidth, the R&S CMP180 will demonstrate at MWC its ability to verify a WLAN waveform with 480 MHz bandwidth in loopback mode, a potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined Wi-Fi 8 (IEEE 802.11bn) standard. This feature shows that the cost-effective instrument is future-proof for users not only in production, but also in R&D.

cited_passages.text: At the core of this test solution is the tried and tested CMX500 5G one-box signaling tester from Rohde & Schwarz. This all-in-one test platform supports both SA and NSA architectures, covers frequency ranges from FR1 to FR3 (up to 18 GHz) and features a built-in IMS server, enabling one-stop testing for RF conformance, protocol validation, VoNR acoustics and carrier aggregation. With these capabilities, the CMX500 serves as a key test platform for 5G-Advanced and 6G research and development.
